reply.english: I work at a big company.

phrases.arabic: قَدِيشْ سْنِينْ وِإِنْتْ عَمْ تِشْتَغِلْ هُونْ؟
phrases.transliteration: addesh sneen w inte 3am tishtghel hon?

reply.english: I'd like to work as a doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: مرحبا لينا، شو بتشتغلي؟
dialogue.transliteration: mar7aba layla, shu btishtghle?
dialogue.english: Hello Layla, what do you do?

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: أهلين فادي، بشتغل ممرضة بالمشفى.
dialogue.transliteration: ahlein fadi, bishtghel mmarrada bil mashfa.
dialogue.english: Hi Fadi, I work as a nurse at the hospital.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: يا سلام، من إمتى وإنتِ بهالشغل؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya salaam, min emta w inte bhal shughel?
dialogue.english: Wow, since when have you been in this job?

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: من سنتين تقريبا.
dialogue.transliteration: min sinteen ta2riban.
dialogue.english: About two years.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: منيح، وأنا لسا بدرس هندسة بالجامعة.
dialogue.transliteration: mnii7, w ana lissa badros handase bil jam3a.
dialogue.english: Good, and I'm still studying engineering at university.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، بأي سنة إنت هلق؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma sha2 allah, bi2ay sane inte halla2?
dialogue.english: Great, what year are you in now?

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: بالسنة الثالثة، وبعدني عم دور عتدريب صيفي.
dialogue.transliteration: bil sane it talte, w ba3dne 3am dawwir 3a tadreeb seife.
dialogue.english: Third year, and I'm still looking for a summer internship.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: طيب لو بدك ممكن اسأل بالمشفى، عندهن دايما محتاجين متدربين.
dialogue.transliteration: tayyeb law biddak mumken as2al bil mashfa, 3andon dayman me7taajeen mitdarrbeen.
dialogue.english: Okay, if you want I can ask at the hospital, they always need trainees.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: الله يخليكي، هيك بتفيديني كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ye5alliki, heik btfeedeeni kteer.
dialogue.english: God keep you, that would help me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.arabic: عن جد ولا يهمك، بسأل بكرا وبحكيلك.
dialogue.transliteration: 3an jad wala yhimmak, bis2al bukra w ba7keelak.
dialogue.english: Really, don't worry, I'll ask tomorrow and tell you.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: تسلمي كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: tislami kteer.
dialogue.english: Thank you so much.

response.english: Yes, I love it a lot.

pair.english: How much longer will you keep studying?

response.english: Two more years and I'll graduate.

lessons.culture: بسوريا كتير مرات أول سؤال بتعرف فيه حدا جديد هو 'شو بتشتغل؟' لأنو الشغل جزء كبير من هوية الشخص. السؤال عن المعاش مباشرة بعتبر قلة ذوق إلا مع صحاب كتير مقربين.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: شو بتشتغل؟ شو بتجاوب؟

too_formal.feedback: صحيحة لكنها فصحى، حدا دمشقي بيقول بشتغل مو بعمل

too_formal.feedback: فصحى رسمية، أهل الشام بيسألوا شو بتشتغل

ir raateb byeeji aakher ish shahr

reply.transliteration: ei fee, la7atta is sa3a tis3a

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير رانيا، شفتي الإيميل تبع المدير؟
dialogue.transliteration: saba7 il 5eer rania, shefti il email taba3 il mudeer?
dialogue.english: Good morning Rania, did you see the manager's email?

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، إي شفتو، في اجتماع الساعة عشرة.
dialogue.transliteration: saba7 in noor, ei shefto, fee ijtima3 is sa3a 3ashra.
dialogue.english: Good morning, yes I saw it, there's a meeting at ten.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: يا الله، وأنا لسا ما خلصت التقرير.
dialogue.transliteration: ya allah, w ana lissa ma khallast it ta2reer.
dialogue.english: Oh no, and I still haven't finished the report.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: خلص بسرعة، المدير هلق كتير متطلب هالأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: khallis bsur3a, il mudeer halla2 kteer mtatalleb hal ayyaam.
dialogue.english: Finish quickly, the manager is very demanding these days.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: عارف عارف، بس الطابعة عم تعطل وما فيني اطبعو.
dialogue.transliteration: 3aaref 3aaref, bass it tabi3a 3am ta3attel w ma feene atba3o.
dialogue.english: I know I know, but the printer keeps breaking and I can't print it.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: خد استخدم الطابعة تبعتي بمكتبي.
dialogue.transliteration: khod isteh dim it tabi3a taba3te bi maktabe.
dialogue.english: Take use my printer in my office.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: الله يخليكي، منيح إنو عندي زميلة متل حالك.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ye5alliki, mnii7 inno 3ende zameele mesl 7aalek.
dialogue.english: God keep you, it's good I have a colleague like you.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: هه ولا يهمك، بس لا تنسى الاجتماع.
dialogue.transliteration: heh wala yhimmak, bass la tinsa il ijtima3.
dialogue.english: Haha no worries, but don't forget the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: ولا يهمك، رح كون جاهز.
dialogue.transliteration: wala yhimmak, ra7 koon jaahez.
dialogue.english: No worries, I'll be ready.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: منيح، وبعد الاجتماع في غدا مع الفريق.
dialogue.transliteration: mnii7, w ba3d il ijtima3 fee ghada ma3 il fareeq.
dialogue.english: Good, and after the meeting there's lunch with the team.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: يعطيكي العافية عليكي، هلأ لازم أخلص هالشغلة.
dialogue.transliteration: ya3teeki il 3aafye 3aleeki, halla2 laazim akhalles hash shughle.
dialogue.english: Bless you, now I have to finish this task.

response.english: Not yet, a bit more and I'll finish it.

response.arabic: لا شكرا، بدي روح عالبيت بدري.
response.transliteration: la shukran, biddi roo7 3al beit badri.
response.english: No thanks, I want to go home early.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: مرحبا نور، وين رايحة؟
dialogue.transliteration: mar7aba noor, wein raay7a?
dialogue.english: Hi Nour, where are you going?

dialogue.arabic: عالمكتبة، عندي امتحان بكرا ولازم أدرس.

dialogue.speaker: Nour

dialogue.transliteration: keemya2, ma fhemet il mo7aadara il akheera mnii7.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: أنا كمان عندي فيها، الدكتور بيحكي بسرعة كتير.
dialogue.transliteration: ana kaman 3ende feeha, id doktor byi7ki bsur3a kteer.
dialogue.english: I have it too, the professor talks very fast.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: صح، فيك تفهمني الجزء تبع التفاعلات؟
dialogue.transliteration: sa77, feek tifhemne il joz2 taba3 it tafaa3olaat?

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: أكيد، تعي نقعد سوا بالمكتبة ونحل الأسئلة.
dialogue.transliteration: akeed, ta3i n2o3od sawa bil maktabe w n7ell il as2ile.
dialogue.english: Sure, come let's sit together at the library and solve the questions.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: يعطيك العافية، بس لازم أسلم كمان واجب قبل الجمعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ya3teek il 3aafye, bass laazim asallem kaman waajeb abl il jum3a.
dialogue.english: Bless you, but I also have to submit an assignment before Friday.

dialogue.speaker: Hassan
dialogue.arabic: ما تخافي، وقتك بيكفي إذا بلشنا هلق.
dialogue.transliteration: ma tkhaafi, wa2tek bikaffi iza ballashna halla2.
dialogue.english: Don't worry, your time is enough if we start now.

dialogue.speaker: Nour

dialogue.english: Okay let's go, come let's go.

dialogue.arabic: يلا، بس أول شي نشرب قهوة.

dialogue.english: Let's go, but first let's drink coffee.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: عمر، شو ناوي تعمل بعد ما تتخرج؟
dialogue.transliteration: 3omar, shu naawi ta3mel ba3d ma tit5arraj?
dialogue.english: Omar, what do you plan to do after you graduate?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: بصراحة لسا ما قررت، بس بفكر أكمل ماجستير.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: إي، بس بعد كم سنة رح رجع وأفتح مشروعي الخاص هون.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: حلو الحلم، وأنا طموحي إني أصير مديرة يوم من الأيام.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: أكيد رح توصلي، إنتِ شاطرة كتير بشغلك.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: الله يسمع منك، المهم أهم شي نرتاح بشغلنا.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: صحيح كتير، الفلوس مهمة بس مو كل شي.
dialogue.transliteration: sa77ee7 kteer, il floos muhimme bass mu koll shi.
dialogue.english: Very true, money is important but not everything.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: يلا الله معك بمشروعك، وأنا الله معي بترقيتي.
dialogue.transliteration: yalla allah ma3ak bi mashroo3ak, w ana allah ma3e bi tar2eyte.
dialogue.english: Well, God be with you in your project, and God be with me in my promotion.

challenge.title: Talk About Your Work or Studies
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Damascene conversation that lasts at least 10 lines about your work or studies and your plans for the future. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 8 and include both a masculine-address form and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A question about profession using شو بتشتغل or شو بتشتغلي.
An answer naming a job or field of study.
A question about where someone works or studies using وين.
A mention of years of experience or year of study using سنة or سنين.
A future plan using رح or بدي or ناوي.
A mention of an ambition or dream using طموحي or حلمي.
The phrase إن شاء الله after a future plan.
A closing exchange such as الله يوفقك or ولا يهمك.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: مايا، شو بتشتغلي هلق؟
dialogue.transliteration: maya, shu btishtghle halla2?
dialogue.english: Maya, what do you do now?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: بشتغل محامية بمكتب صغير، وإنت؟
dialogue.transliteration: bishtghel mo7amiye bi maktab zgheer, w inte?
dialogue.english: I work as a lawyer at a small office, and you?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: أنا لسا بدرس اقتصاد بالجامعة، بالسنة الرابعة.
dialogue.transliteration: ana lissa badros iqtisaad bil jam3a, bis sane ir raab3a.
dialogue.english: I'm still studying economics at university, in the fourth year.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: ما شاء الله، وبعد ما تتخرج شو ناوي تعمل؟
dialogue.transliteration: ma sha2 allah, w ba3d ma tit5arraj shu naawi ta3mel?
dialogue.english: Wonderful, and after you graduate what do you plan to do?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled

dialogue.transliteration: biddi 2addem 3a wazeefe bi bank, in sha2 allah bla2i shi mnii7.
dialogue.english: I want to apply for a job at a bank, God willing I'll find something good.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: إن شاء الله، وطموحك شو بالمستقبل؟
dialogue.transliteration: in sha2 allah, w tamoo7ak shu bil mostaqbal?
dialogue.english: God willing, and what's your ambition for the future?

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: طموحي إني أصير مدير فرع يوم من الأيام.
dialogue.transliteration: tamoo7e inne aseer mudeer far3 yom min il ayyaam.
dialogue.english: My ambition is to become a branch manager one day.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: حلو كتير، أنا كمان بدي كمل دراستي عالماجستير بالقانون.
dialogue.transliteration: 7ilo kteer, ana kaman biddi kammel diraaste 3al majesteer bil qaanoon.
dialogue.english: Very nice, I also want to continue my studies for a master's in law.

dialogue.speaker: Khaled
dialogue.arabic: الله يوفقك، رح توصلي أكيد.
dialogue.transliteration: allah ywaffe2ek, ra7 towsale akeed.
dialogue.english: God grant you success, you'll definitely get there.

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.arabic: يسلمو، وياريت كمان توصل عهدفك.
dialogue.transliteration: yislamu, w yareet kaman towsal 3a hadafak.
dialogue.english: Thank you, and I hope you reach your goal too.
